summary.intent: Land a lint fix commit and a Rust (FUSE + WinFsp + core) fix along with a unified cross-platform test, all signed.
summary.outcome: Lint commit was verified as landed and signed; Rust changes and the unified cross-platform test were staged and committed (signed).

repo: The project uses signed commits (GPG or SSH signing) as a standard practice.
Cross-platform sync testing is covered by a shell script under tests/desktop-e2e/scripts/.

code.finding: This script implements the unified cross-platform client sync test introduced in this session.

workflow: Commits were staged and created in discrete steps (lint fix first, then Rust + test), keeping the history bisectable.
Signing was verified explicitly after each commit rather than assumed.
